name: UNEP Legislation
project_description:
This module provides a content type to store and present legislative content in Drupal. It also implements an API integration with the Laws.Africa Indigo platform https://github.com/laws-africa/indigo to import legislation from Akoma-Ntoso format.

 Features 
 Content type, taxonomies to store legislative content.

API module integrated with Migrate to import automatically legislation.

Supports multilingual features and ammendment as revisions for the legislation.
